name: CodeJudgeBench
description: CodeJudgeBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate the performance of LLMs acting as judges in coding tasks, specifically code generation, code repair, and unit test generation. It assesses the reliability and consistency of LLM-as-a-Judge models and explores optimal prompting strategies for judging code quality.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark focused on LLM-as-a-judge reliability for code tasks, with interest mainly from the code evaluation and benchmarking community.
notes: Highlights randomness and sensitivity in LLM judging; studies prompting strategies for improved judge performance.
